message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 25 cards + 8 Wild cards) | | **Players** | 2–10 | | **Goal** | Be the first to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round). | | **Setup** | Shuffle → Deal 7 cards each → Place remaining deck face‑down → Flip top card to start discard pile. | | **Turn** | 1️⃣ Draw a card if you cannot play. 2️⃣ Play one or more cards that match color, number, or symbol. 3️⃣ If you play your last card, shout “Uno!” before the next player draws. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
• **Wild** – Change current color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Change color; next player draws four cards (must be played only if you have no matching card). | | **Scoring** | After a player goes out, other players score points based on cards left in their hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning** | First to reach 500 points (or agreed target). | **Key Rules** 1. **Matching** – You may play a card if it matches the top card’s color, number, or symbol. 2. **Wild Cards** – Can be played at any time; you declare the new color. 3. **Draw Penalties** – If you cannot play, you must draw until you can or until the deck runs out. 4. **Uno Call** – When you have one card left, you must say “Uno!” before the next player takes a turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty (draw two cards). 5. **Stacking** – Some house rules allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards. 6. **End of Game** – When a player goes out, the round ends; points are tallied. **Optional House Rules** - **Stacking** – Allow players to stack Draw Two/Wild Draw Four cards. - **No Draw** – Players may choose not to draw if they cannot play. - **Card Count** – Keep track of cards left in the deck to avoid running out. Enjoy playing Uno!
